people.name: Barabbas
people.line: A notorious prisoner released instead of Jesus.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

people.name: Pilate
people.line: Roman governor who presided over Jesus' trial

translations.web: Pilate, wishing to please the multitude, released Barabbas to them, and handed over Jesus, when he had flogged him, to be crucified.
translations.bsb: And wishing to satisfy the crowd, Pilate released Barabbas to them. But he had Jesus flogged, and handed Him over to be crucified.
translations.kjv: And so Pilate, willing to content the people, released Barabbas unto them, and delivered Jesus, when he had scourged him, to be crucified.
translations.asv: And Pilate, wishing to content the multitude, released unto them Barabbas, and delivered Jesus, when he had scourged him, to be crucified.
